intro: Quiet moments behind a house full of guests: plates finished, glasses polished and fresh linen ready for the next room.

scenes.title: Before dessert
scenes.description: Lemon tart and raspberries are plated at the upper-basement service-kitchen island, ready for service.

scenes.title: Before dinner
scenes.description: Glasses are polished and a tray assembled in the raised-ground butler’s pantry, close to the dining room.

scenes.title: Between stays
scenes.description: Towels and table linen are folded at the laundry worktable, with garment care kept in its own service space.
